inputs.original_text: The measures follow the passage of Bill C-12, also known as the Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act, which received royal assent on March 26, 2026. The post Canada tightens immigration, asylum rules against Nigerians, others appeared first on Vanguard News .
inputs.modified_text: They’re framing this as routine border and immigration policy, but the timing is the tell: the measures follow Bill C-12 receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026. Calling it the “Strengthening Canada’s Immigration System and Borders Act” makes expanded control sound reassuring, while the headline singles out Nigerians and others. That looks less like neutral administration and more like a coordinated push to normalize tighter restrictions under the cover of security.
